h1: Saalbach-Hinterglemm ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Saalbach Hinterglemm rings the Glemm valley with 270 kilometres of pistes across Salzburg and Tyrol, and 140 of those kilometres are graded blue - more than half the ski area. A winding 3.2-kilometre run leads down to the centre of Hinterglemm.
stayOverview: Saalbach on the valley floor is the livelier end; Hinterglemm further up is quieter and better for families; Leogang over the ridge is on the same pass and cheaper.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The circuit means you can start anywhere on the ring and come back by lift.
rentalCars: Zell am See has the nearest railway station, about twenty kilometres away, and a car or transfer is the normal way in.
